title: Roswell ignored until Berlitz's 1980 book
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Roswell ignored until Berlitz's 1980 book, about 1947-1980 at Roswell, New Mexico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Ros Roswell as an incident didn't become a thing until 1980 [snorts] when the litz wrote his book about it and then Stanton Freeman and others got involved

plain: A well-known skeptic, Michael Shermer, says the 1947 Roswell incident, a reported crash in New Mexico, did not become a big story until 1980, when the writer Charles Berlitz published a book about it called The Roswell Incident. According to Shermer, the researcher Stanton Friedman and others only took it up after that, which in his view shows the legend was built decades later.
